verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking web and mobile app, so letting users opt out of analytics or usage tracking is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, privacy settings or any opt-out control. The cited material covers only accounts, cards, transfers, invoicing and accounting integrations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
